body_markdown: Inspiration in entrepreneurship often comes from looking beyond your own business and taking note of what other are doing around you in your industry. As a CEO of three companies under SERHANT. I have recently started to take interest in investing in some startups I think are aligned with a mission to transform their industry like never before. I asked for you all to submit your pitches so I can share my thoughts on the pitch, idea, and potential investor mindset. I hope my commentary helps not inly the entrepreneurs who submitted, but also any of you looking to start your own venture or launch your business into the world of venture capital.
